jobs.description: The 주소정보 전자지도 daily changes from the official 데이터 연계 of 주소기반산업지원서비스 (root ADR-0475; scripts/ops/juso-electronic-map-cycle.sh). For each request code (cntc_cd) of juso-electronic-map.contract.json, from its own cursor (the next day to ask, in the state directory) to yesterday in KST, it asks update.juso.go.kr/updateInfo.do with the approval key for windows of at most ten days, oldest first, always naming the window so an ask can be repeated. Every file of an answer (a 100-byte header and a zip) lands byte for byte in the Bronze of every kind its code serves (jusogokr__<kind>, the catalog's 11), named by the file, its retry flag and its making date, so landing it twice is the committer's idempotent success; the cursor moves only after a window's files are all committed. The history starts at 2020-01-01 (the contract's backfill.first_day): about 251 windows per code, 30 per run, so about nine daily runs catch up. Without the key (runtime-secrets group juso) the run asks nothing and ends waiting; a refusal (the key or a code not ours) stops every ask and fails the run so the unit's OnFailure raises the alert, and the next scheduled run asks again by itself. No Spark: the Silver per kind follows in its own change (root ADR-0475 §5).

first_run.estimated_from: computed, no neighbour asks this provider: 4 request codes x 30 windows = 120 asks at the contract's 3 s spacing (360 s), and at most the contract's 6,000,000,000 bytes per run received at about 20 MB/s (300 s) and written to R2 once per kind it serves (300001 twice, 300003 three times, 300006 five times: about 3.5 times the received bytes at the measured 50 MB/s of the data.go.kr file collector's 349 MB zip, about 420 s); 2,400 s is about twice that sum and a third of the 7,200 s limit. The first run with the key is the measurement (root ADR-0457 §3); runs that end waiting for the key are not

assets.title: 주소정보 전자지도 변동분 매일 받기
assets.description: 공식 데이터 연계(update.juso.go.kr/updateInfo.do, 승인키 하나)로 요청 코드(cntc_cd 300001·300002·300003·300006)마다 자기 커서부터 어제(KST)까지 10일 창을 묻고, 받은 파일(100바이트 머리 + zip)을 그 코드가 맡는 종류마다 Bronze(jusogokr__<kind>)에 그대로 남긴다. 2020-01-01 부터 run 당 30창씩 따라잡는다. 승인키가 없으면 묻지 않고 기다린다(루트 ADR-0475).

assets.title: 주소정보 전자지도
assets.description: 주소정보 전자지도 11종(건물·출입구·건물군·도로구간·기초구간·실폭도로·국가기초구역·법정구역 시도·시군구·읍면동·리). 매달 손으로 신청하는 전자지도 내려받기 대신, 사장이 한 번 한 데이터 연계 신청의 승인키로 매일 변동분을 자동으로 받는다(루트 ADR-0475, ADR-0355 §3 을 고침). 승인키가 놓이기 전에는 수집 작업이 기다리고, 놓인 뒤 첫 일정의 run 이 측정이다. 받은 객체가 아직 0 이고 Silver 가 없어 planned 다.
